title: When to Publish?
author: stowned_the_first
selftext:
Got a fairly decent Unity + Claude project going, been playing and reviewing myself, have sent to a couple friends and plan on sending to a few more for feedback but I think the real question is at what point do I publish and what's the best option. 

Currently leaning towards doing an early access on steam, but also wondering about Google play store as an option?

What's everyone's experience been with publishing an early access version and getting feedback? At what point do you know it's ready to go to the public? I also plan on being very transparent about the AI use.

comments.author: StoneCypher
comments.body:
The correct time to publish on Steam is once you've crossed 7500 wishlists, because that is when the platform will begin to promote you.

The correct time for other platforms can be different.  

Google Play is mostly about advertising.  If you're an indie, Steam will be much easier for you.

replies.author: stowned_the_first
replies.body:
And I guess getting those wishlists is best achieved via a demo/early access and various other bits of marketing? 

My concern with going public for early access/demo (maybe unjustified) is that my concept gets ripped off and pushed out by someone with a much higher marketing budget/reach than me.

replies.author: Ambitious_Catch_8948
replies.body:
lo que mas te debe preocupar es que steam calculara tu visibilidad en funcion del tiron que genere tu primera publicación (sea early acces, demo o juego completo) asi q mas vale que tengas bien pulido el producto,   
steam mostrara tu juego un poco, sobretodo si estas e un steam next fest (pero para eso tienes q informarte bien de como funciona entrar a uno). pero la mayoria de esas wishlist mas vale q las hayas farmeado fuera de steam y de antes, discord, tiktok, x, aqui (si no te banean por hacer publicidad de tu juego) itch etc son buenos sitios para empezar a darse a conocer.   
y sino, paga una campaña de marketing para llegar a esos 7.5k (si quieres presupuesto enviame un DM) y asegurarte un lanzamiento como siempre has soñado.

replies.author: Flag_Shagger
replies.body: what kind of budget do you need to hit that many wishlists?

replies.author: Ambitious_Catch_8948
replies.body:
depende de muchas cosas... producto, target, punto de partida, prisa, canales, etc.    
mejor seguir por privado, enviame mensaje al chat

replies.author: StoneCypher
replies.body: yes, unless you have deep pockets, at which point advertising is better

replies.author: Flag_Shagger
replies.body: pretty sure this is outdated information it’s more like 12,000 or something
